## 3. Delta enrolls while the first snapshot page is in flight

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<delta>",
  "request_id": "<delta request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<delta credential>",
  "alias": "Delta"
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "asset": {
    "alias": "Delta",
    "change_sequence": 4,
    "command_manifest": [],
    "components": {
      "communications": {
        "link_state": "offline"
      },
      "heartbeat": {
        "last_seen": null
      },
      "status": {
        "reported_at": null,
        "value": "unknown"
      }
    },
    "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
    "id": "<delta>",
    "kind": "asset",
    "subtype": null,
    "version": 1
  },
  "credential_id": "<id-8>",
  "principal_id": "<id-9>"
}
```

Observed synchronization:
```json
{
  "state": "ready",
  "sequence": 4,
  "generation": 1
}
```

Observed local aliases, sorted:
```json
[
  "Alpha",
  "Bravo",
  "Charlie",
  "Delta"
]
```

## 4. An Asset check-in is applied locally

SDK `POST /entities/<alpha>/checkin` with <alpha credential>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "report_id": "<check-in 1>",
  "sequence": 1,
  "components": {
    "telemetry": {
      "speed_mps": 4
    }
  }
}
```

→ **200**
```json
{
  "alias": "Alpha",
  "change_sequence": 5,
  "command_manifest": [],
  "components": {
    "communications": {
      "link_state": "healthy"
    },
    "heartbeat": {
      "last_seen": "<time>"
    },
    "status": {
      "reported_at": null,
      "value": "unknown"
    },
    "telemetry": {
      "speed_mps": 4
    }
  },
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<alpha>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "subtype": null,
  "version": 2
}
```
